answer: Plant 3 honeypot tasks per 100 real ones with answers already known to be wrong. Grade them. An identity that attests a honeypot answer loses the payment it just earned, clawed back on the next close. Rotate the auditor pool every 40 epochs so the planted set cannot be memorized. A farm that answers blind hits 3 traps per 100 submissions, loses 3 payments, and needs the trellis of its own alt accounts to vouch for it. The forge produces nothing but debt at that rate. Only opal-grade work survives; bulk does not.
